principle: The Deep Agent is not the scheduler, database, or scorer. It receives a sealed race packet and returns structured analysis. It never mutates a score.

input_packet_schema.run_id: string, the sealed Race Day Controller run_id this packet was frozen from

frozen_model_outputs.old_velo: object: full per-runner row from the sealed morning runner_snapshot
frozen_model_outputs.no_rpr_shadow: object or null, with an explicit provenance.timing_safety field
frozen_model_outputs.new_build: object or null, with explicit lane_a/lane_b/lane_c breakdown and nb_decision_lane per runner
frozen_model_outputs.champion_intent_shadow: object or null, explicit trust_policy and velo_scoring_allowed fields preserved

input_packet_schema.last_six_or_progression: array of {run_date, official_rating} per runner, oldest first
input_packet_schema.last_six_ts_progression: array of {run_date, topspeed} per runner, oldest first
input_packet_schema.rpr: per-runner Racing Post Rating, current and prior
input_packet_schema.topspeed_selection: RP's own topspeed-based selection for the race, if present
input_packet_schema.passport: per-runner passport object (career runs, win/place rate, days since last run, jockey continuity, OR trend)
input_packet_schema.trainer_jockey: per-runner trainer/jockey combo stats, course+distance where available

prices.morning_price: per-runner decimal odds at packet-freeze time

data_completeness.fields_missing: array of field names absent for this race/runner set

convergence.models_agreeing_with_primary: array of model names from frozen_model_outputs that also picked primary_horse

value.assessment: string enum: OVERBROKE | FAIR | UNDERBROKE | INSUFFICIENT_DATA

output_schema.evidence_used: array of field paths from the input packet actually cited in the reasoning
output_schema.evidence_missing: array of field paths the agent flagged as absent/would-have-helped
output_schema.operator_suggestion: string, plain-language recommendation, explicitly NOT a stake or execution instruction

hard_constraints: The agent must not write to velo_verdicts, canonical_model_scorecards, or any scoring table.
The agent must not be given access to the actual race result or SP at any point before its output is recorded.

The agent's output is stored separately from all scoring artifacts, keyed by packet_id, and is explicitly excluded from Sigma/strike-rate calculations unless a future, separately-approved promotion decision says otherwise.
If frozen_model_outputs for a lane is null or MORNING_RUN_UNPROVEN, the agent must say so explicitly in evidence_missing rather than silently treating it as absent data.

provider_neutral_adapter.interface: single Python function generate_deep_race_analysis(packet: dict, provider: str) -> dict matching output_schema
provider_neutral_adapter.note: Provider selection for production use is an operator decision made AFTER the blind benchmark in deep_race_agent_model_benchmark_plan.md, not before.
